chain_words.nuance: mildly agreeable to look at or experience
warm and charming in appearance or feeling
a general high standard of visual or artistic beauty
so impressive that it takes your breath away

explanation: These words all describe something pleasing to look at or experience, with intensity rising from mild pleasantness to overwhelming impressiveness.

usage_notes.difference: 'Attractive' describes something that draws interest, while 'stunning' describes something so striking that it amazes the viewer.
